title: Heat Shock Proteins in Cancer: Mechanisms and Therapeutic Targeting.
snippet: Heat shock proteins (HSPs) are molecular chaperones that couple proteostasis to cancer metabolic reprogramming under oncogenic and microenvironmental stress. This Review integrates structural, biochemical, preclinical, and clinical evidence on HSP90, HSP70, HSP60, HSP40, HSP110, and small HSPs.
